title: RynnValue Scales Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance
summary: RynnValue from Alibaba DAMO Academy trains robotic value foundation models using temporal distance as the learning signal — how far a state is from the goal in time — instead of hand-designed task rewards. The release includes code and a project page covering the scaling behaviour of these value models.
whyItMatters: Reward design is the quiet bottleneck in robot learning: every new task needs a new hand-tuned signal. Temporal distance is available from any recorded trajectory, so value learning can ride the same unlabeled-data scaling curve that policy learning already does, and a shared value model can then be reused across tasks that never had rewards written for them.
